title: A principal-only loan chargeback credits the FUND_SOURCE 250.00 and debits LOAN_PORTFOLIO 250.00 (loan 14 L69)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a loan CHARGEBACK posted on a loan that is NOT charged off, the principal-only shape, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP1 / product 6) at the chargeback transaction. request.chargeback_journal.amount is the accepted chargeback request transactionAmount 250.0 -> "25000" minor units, raised with paymentTypeId 2 (loans/loan-14/loan-14-chargeback-request.json); transaction_id L69 is the journal entries' transaction id for the read-back's transaction id 69 (type loanTransactionType.chargeback). request.chargeback_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's chargeback transaction id 69 after the chargeback: principalPortion 250.0 -> "25000", overpaymentPortion absent -> "0"; the observed identity amount = principal + overpayment holds (25000 = 25000 + 0). request.chargeback_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request product-mappings/create-request-LP1.json: fundSourceAccountId 4, loanPortfolioAccountId 10, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 18; paymentTypeId 2 has no channel mapping (the one channel mapping is paymentTypeId 1 -> 17), so the default FUND_SOURCE 4 applies, exactly the account the observed credit names. expect.chargeback_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L69 legs in id order: JE 148 CREDIT account 4 250.0, JE 149 DEBIT account 10 250.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a chargeback credits the amount to the resolved fund source and debits the principal credited beyond paid to LOAN_PORTFOLIO, in posting order. It is the shape where a port that debits the overpayment portion to LOAN_PORTFOLIO (or anywhere) is INVISIBLE, because there is no overpayment portion here; the overpayment-to-portfolio drive is discriminated by the loan-19 and loan-21 vectors. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every amount, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
